title: Minimum Cost Tree From Leaf Values
inputFormat: Implement mctFromLeafValues(arr). The positive integers in arr must be the leaf values in left-to-right order; they cannot be rearranged.
outputFormat: Return the minimum sum of internal-node values. Do not include leaf values or return a tree.

visuals.title: Example 1: internal cost 32
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 420 220" role="img" aria-labelledby="leaf-cost-title" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:420px;color:var(--color-text)"><title id="leaf-cost-title">Leaves 6, 2, and 4 form a tree with internal costs 24 and 8, totaling 32</title><g stroke="currentColor" fill="none"><path d="M120 47L50 100M120 47L190 100M190 117L150 175M190 117L230 175"/><circle cx="120" cy="30" r="22" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="190" cy="100" r="20" stroke-width="2"/></g><g fill="currentColor" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif" text-anchor="middle" font-size="17"><text x="120" y="36">24</text><text x="190" y="106">8</text><text x="50" y="119">6</text><text x="150" y="193">2</text><text x="230" y="193">4</text></g><g fill="currentColor" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif" font-size="13"><text x="270" y="74">Internal costs only:</text><text x="270" y="102">24 + 8 = 32</text><text x="270" y="130">Return 32</text><text x="18" y="216">Leaf order: 6 → 2 → 4</text></g></svg>
visuals.caption: Circled values are internal-node costs. The root uses leaf maxima 6 and 4, so its value is 24, not 6 × 8.
